steps.sub: Three extra two-qubit gates, each with its own error and execution time

eyebrow: A verified look at a larger circuit
code:
40 native 2-qubit gates (ideal connectivity)
+ 20 SWAPs × 3 CNOTs = 60 CNOTs
= 100 total two-qubit ops

At 0.5%/gate error:
  40 gates alone  → ~18% error chance
  100 gates total → ~39% error chance
caption: Routing overhead alone is now responsible for more than half the circuit's total error risk — without the algorithm itself changing at all.
